gloss: to set up; to prepare; to adopt a stance

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {構|かま}えていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To establish or set up a place such as a home, shop, or office.

definitions.gloss: to adopt a stance; to prepare oneself
definitions.explanation: To take a physical or mental posture in preparation for something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{構|かま}える。
⟦{斜|はす}→斜：00093_hasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{構|かま}えた⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よくない→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: A cynical attitude is not good.
examples.notes: 「{斜|はす}に{構|かま}える」 means to take a cynical or aloof stance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{構|かま}える。
examples.english: To set up an office in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{郊外|こうがい}→郊外：01403_kougai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{構|かま}え、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦{四人|よにん}→四人：30566_yonin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: My older brother got married and set up a home in the suburbs, and now lives there as a family of four.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧); no intransitive pair. ({構|かま}う, to mind or to look after, is a different verb.)
- Also used without an object for a mental stance: どっしり{構|かま}える (to stay calm and unshaken), {構|かま}えて⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (to wait at the ready)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{構|かま}える (set up a shop)
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{構|かま}える (establish a home)
- ⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{構|かま}える (ready one's sword)
- ⟦{斜|はす}→斜：00093_hasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{構|かま}える (take a cynical stance)

ASPECT (ている):
- {構|かま}えて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ can indicate either an ongoing state of readiness or an established setup.
